# Aryan Swaroop

> Brand Designer & Creative Lead based in Bengaluru, India. Specializes in brand identity systems, packaging design, 3D visualization, video production, UI/UX, and creative direction. Also builds web products using React, Next.js, and Supabase. Currently open to full-time Creative Lead or Brand Designer roles. The portfolio tagline: "Not another portfolio. Just my best work."

## About

Aryan Swaroop is a multidisciplinary designer with 2.5+ years of experience leading creative end-to-end — from brand strategy through to shipped results. Based in Bengaluru, India. Expertise spans real estate branding, F&B packaging, consumer brand identity, digital campaigns, and front-end web development. The portfolio features 9 portrait cursor-reveal images, refined hero stats (300+ Qualified Leads, 30+ Projects Led, 50+ Films Produced), and an endless-runner game on the 404 page.

## Projects & Case Studies

- [Real Estate](https://www.aryanswaroop.com/real-estate): Paavani Properties, Sidvin Serenity, Royal Farm, VR Devaiah Enclave — brand identity, 3D visualization, print, and campaign work across 30+ launches. Generated 302 leads in 66 days at ₹82/lead.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.aryanswaroop.com/lifestyle): Sastry's by Brahmi (coffee packaging), Isha V (security & facility management), Snehaloka Cricket Academy — full identity systems built from scratch.
- [Builds](https://www.aryanswaroop.com/builds): Selixo, AlbumFlow, Striv, Foundations — live web products designed and shipped in React, Next.js, and Supabase.
- [Playground](https://www.aryanswaroop.com/playground): Motion, renders, and behind-the-scenes experiments.
- [Tools](https://www.aryanswaroop.com/tools): Skills overview and downloadable resume.

## Experience

- Creative Lead at Paavani Properties and Marketing (2024–2026): Led execution across 30+ real estate projects. Produced 50+ marketing videos, full 3D render suite, and a Meta Ads system generating 302 leads in 66 days.
- Branding Designer at Destiny (2023–2024): Built brand identities for 10+ clients, delivered 100+ digital creatives and 15+ videos.
- Graphic Designer & Video Editor at Director In (2022–2023): Shot founder interviews, restructured long-form content for short-form platforms.
